  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED` row says a `stale_workflow=hand_back_failed` head is "retried next tick, except after `dispatch_failed`". It leaves out `superseded`, which also produces `hand_back_failed` (scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:245-247) and is not retried.
  WHY: The stale marker carries the old head SHA, so the next tick checks the new head, the marker does not match, and the old SHA is never retried; the in-script comment at scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:228-235 states this correctly. This is a documentation-only inaccuracy that every reviewer rated NIT, mapped here to low.
- agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md:9 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contractual "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" bullet for `stale_workflow=hand_back_failed` lists `read_failed`, `marker_failed`, `disabled` and `dispatch_failed` but leaves out `superseded`, which implies a superseded head is retried.
  WHY: This fragment is folded into agents.md as the canonical log-line reference and contradicts the script comment at scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:228-235, so operators will expect a retry that never happens. Reviewers rated it NIT, mapped to low.
- README.md:184-186 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` and `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX` rows say "the pass still reads each failed candidate's comments" (reason `base_sync_disabled` / `cap_zero`). Candidates hitting `failed_at_unknown`, `too_recent` or `review_in_flight` return before `_pr_base_sync_count` (scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:266-279), so they get no reads.
  WHY: The documentation overstates the per-tick API reads and gives the wrong skip reason for those candidates; the code behaviour is correct. Reviewers rated it NIT, mapped to low.
- agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md:5 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The bullet says "the pass still reads each failed candidate's comments within the per-tick cap". This repeats the README:184-186 overstatement, although the early returns at scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:266-278 skip the comments read.
  WHY: The folded agents.md repeats the overstated claim as the canonical reference for the script's behaviour, so the per-tick cost is overestimated. Reviewers rated it NIT, mapped to low.
- changelog.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md:11 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog table says "one `user` and one comments read per failed head", which overcounts reads for the early-return candidates (`failed_at_unknown`, `too_recent`, `review_in_flight`).
  WHY: This is the same documentation over-count as README.md:184-186; the behaviour is correct and cheaper than documented. Rated NIT, mapped to low.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:`FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED` row (related: scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh line 246) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row lists `dispatch_failed` as the only `hand_back_failed` case that is not retried next tick. `outcome=superseded` also produces `hand_back_failed` and is not retried, because the stale marker names the old SHA. The README row and the agents.d contractual bullet both leave this out; the sweep script comment covers it.
  WHY: This is a documentation-only error. Operators are told the head will retry, but it never does for that SHA. The README row and agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md disagree with the script comment.
- README.md:`FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` / `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX` rows (related: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh lines 266-277, `_pr_base_sync_count` at line 279) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rows say every failed candidate gets the comments read. Candidates with an invalid failed_at, `too_recent` or `review_in_flight` `return 2` before any API call and log those reasons, not `cap_zero` / `base_sync_disabled`.
  WHY: The documentation overstates the API reads and misstates the skip reason; behaviour is otherwise correct and bounded by the per-tick cap.

It leaves out `superseded` (scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:245-247), which is not retryable because the stale marker carries the old head SHA. The script comment at scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:228-235 is correct.
  WHY: Operators will expect a retry after `superseded`. This is a documentation accuracy issue from the last autofix run, not a behaviour regression.
- agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md:9 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Same omission as README.md:180. The contractual log-prefix bullet lists `read_failed`, `marker_failed`, `disabled` and `dispatch_failed` but leaves out `superseded`.
  WHY: The fragment is folded into agents.md by `scripts/assemble_agents.py` as the canonical reference, so readers will expect a retry after `superseded`.
- README.md:184 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row says that with `false` "the pass still reads each failed candidate's comments … reason `base_sync_disabled`". The `failed_at_unknown` (266-269), `too_recent` (271-274) and `review_in_flight` (275-278) returns in scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh happen before `_pr_base_sync_count`.
  WHY: Operators will overcount one `user` read plus one comments read per early-return candidate, and the error compounds across ticks.
- README.md:186 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Same overstatement for "`0` stops syncing, but the pass still reads each failed candidate's comments, reason `cap_zero`". The early-return candidates do not reach `_pr_base_sync_count`, and `cap_zero` is not logged for them.
  WHY: Same API-cost overestimate as line 184.
- agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md:5 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: This mirrors the README:184-186 overstatement ("the pass still reads each failed candidate's comments within the per-tick cap"), despite the early returns at scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:266-278.
  WHY: The folded agents.md repeats the overstated per-tick cost.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- README.md:180 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED` row says `hand_back_failed` is retried next tick except after `dispatch_failed`, and leaves out `superseded`.
  WHY: `review_final_ci_failed.sh` returns `superseded` when the head changed. The stale marker is tied to the old SHA, so that head is not retried and the new head follows its own final-CI path.
- README.md:184, 186 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` / `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX` rows say comments are read for each failed candidate, without noting the earlier eligibility checks.
  WHY: In `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`, candidates with an unknown or too-recent failure time, or an active review, return before `_pr_base_sync_count` (lines 265–279), so the documented read count is too high.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- README.md:180 (also agents.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md line 9) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The row claims every `hand_back_failed` head is retried except after `dispatch_failed`, but `superseded` also produces `hand_back_failed` and is never retried. `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:245-247` logs `outcome=superseded` before any marker POST, and the grep at `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:236-240` then sets `hand_back_failed`. The stale marker `head=${sync_stale_head}` in `_pr_base_sync_count` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`) does not match the new head. The agents.d bullet at line 9 has the same omission, while the comment at lines 228-235 is correct.
  WHY: There is no code failure, but these are contractual operator documents, and an operator will expect a superseded head to retry and misdiagnose the stall.
- README.md:184, 186 (also changelog.d/10093-final-ci-stale-workflow-sync.md line 11, agents.d fragment line 5) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rows say every failed candidate gets the comments read when syncing is off or the cap is 0. In `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`, `failed_at_unknown` (266-268), `too_recent` (271-273) and `review_in_flight` (275-277) all `return 2` before `_pr_base_sync_count` at line 279, and those candidates are not counted against the cap (header lines 244-247).
  WHY: There is no code failure, and the code is cheaper than documented. Operators will overestimate reads; the same over-count appears in the changelog table ("one `user` and one comments read per failed head") and the agents.d fragment.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
